title: A Cauldron Forged from Source
summary: Ye Fan spends a festival day with the little girl Nannan and promises to take her somewhere higher before saying goodbye. He retrieves his hidden Source and, copying the Green Copper's innate Dao patterns and using Fire Fiend spiritual energy, refines a three-legged cauldron as his artifact, reasoning that great vessels mature late. Heading to the town nearest the Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land, where ancient families are recruiting for an expedition to the sacred mountain for divine medicine, he reunites with his old classmate Zhang Wenchang, who is homesick and feels he will never amount to anything. When Junior Brother Han and fellow Yuding disciples mock and threaten them, Ye Fan beats the Bitter Sea cultivators with his bare strength.
events: Ye Fan bids farewell to Nannan with a pinky promise
He refines a three-legged cauldron from Source using the Green Copper's Dao patterns and Fire Fiend energy
Crowds gather near the Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land, where ancient families seek divine medicine
Ye Fan reunites with Wenchang, who was sent along only to make up the numbers
Junior Brother Han and his fellow disciples attack; Ye Fan overpowers them
cultivation: Ye Fan refines his personal artifact, a cauldron patterned on the Green Copper's Dao patterns; he later says 'one cauldron can break ten thousand arts.'

title: Life Spring Blood at the River
summary: Wenchang urges Ye Fan to flee because a Life Spring cultivator backs the bullies, but Ye Fan is ambushed by Senior Brother Chen Feng, a peak Life Spring cultivator of Yuding Cave Heaven, and Junior Brother Han. Ye Fan reveals that he too has reached Life Spring, kills Chen Feng with his cauldron, and kills Han after revealing he slew Han's great-uncle Elder Han and took his Green Wood Seal and spirit herbs. Elder Ma Yun arrives, is shocked that an Ancient Desolate Sacred Body can cultivate, and offers Ye Fan a place in Yuding; he declines, and she agrees to take Wenchang as her disciple and keep Ye Fan's secret. In town, the Ji family hands out a medicine said to resist the Forbidden Land's curse to recruits, a ragged madman babbles that everyone will die, and the Jiang and Ji families' main forces march toward the Forbidden Land.
events: Ye Fan kills peak Life Spring cultivator Chen Feng
He kills Junior Brother Han, having already killed Han's great-uncle Elder Han
The Green Wood Seal now obeys Ye Fan as its new master
Elder Ma Yun takes Wenchang as her disciple and agrees to keep Ye Fan's secret
The Ji family recruits cultivators with a curse-resisting medicine
A madman warns of mountains of corpses as the Jiang and Ji forces arrive
introduced: Ji family medicine against the Forbidden Land's curse
cultivation: Ye Fan reveals he has reached the Life Spring realm (thanks to Elder Han's spirit herbs) and defeats a peak Life Spring cultivator.

title: The Madman Who Shrinks Earth
summary: The ancient families' army enters the wilds of the Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land, but a vicious Great Peng bird ambushes the vanguard and wipes them out despite their combined attacks. The raving old madman, crying 'rivers of blood, endless dry bones', walks away with steps that span several li and form Dao patterns, and Ye Fan follows him; the man speaks of returning to see his fellow disciples and hints at the Tianxuan Sacred Land annihilated there 6,000 years ago, before telling Ye Fan to go back. Three months later, word spreads that everyone who entered died, yet the ancient families plan another expedition. Ye Fan meets his old classmate Lin Jia, now of Yanxia Cave Heaven and watched by Jiang family guards, who warns him to leave before the ancient families learn he has been in the Forbidden Land.
events: A Great Peng bird annihilates the expedition's vanguard
The madman uses a Shrinking the Earth step that forms Dao patterns
Ye Fan follows him and learns of Tianxuan Sacred Land's destruction 6,000 years ago
The ancient families prepare a second expedition
Lin Jia reunites with Ye Fan and warns him to leave
cultivation: The madman displays a movement art forming Dao patterns comparable to the mighty experts of antiquity.

title: Hostage on the Cursed Mountain
summary: The Jiang family cultivator who hunted Ye Fan two years earlier catches him, and the Jiang elder has him armored and kept alive because he has entered the Forbidden Land before. Elder Jiang and Elder Ji squabble over who should enter first, then lead their forces in together; inside, their Life Springs seal and divine power vanishes, yet Ye Fan's does not. The aura of desolation strikes, and skeletons, apparently Tianxuan experts from 6,000 years ago, crawl out of the Ancient Desolate Abyss. When the elders threaten to kill Ye Fan's friends Ziwen and Xiaoman for refusing to climb for the divine fruit, Ye Fan says he has eaten divine fruit before and offers to gather it, on condition that his friends go free and he gets to kill his Jiang pursuer, then slaps the cultivator.
events: Ye Fan is captured by the Jiang family cultivator who hunted him
Elders Jiang and Ji lead their families into the Forbidden Land together
Divine power is sealed inside, but Ye Fan's is not
The aura of desolation and crawling skeletons terrorize the group
Ye Fan bargains to gather the divine fruit and slaps his pursuer
cultivation: Ye Fan's divine power keeps working inside the Forbidden Land, which the elders suspect is due to his Sacred Body and the divine fruit.

title: A Mortal Slaps a Cultivator
summary: Ye Fan beats and humiliates the Jiang cultivator who hunted him, forcing him to his knees, while the elders let the fight play out and note how much the divine fruit strengthened his body. Elder Jiang privately wonders whether the skeletons crawling out are linked to the bronze coffin that Tianxuan Sacred Land once attacked this place for. Ye Fan offers to gather the divine medicine if they clear the skeletons and free his friends, but is refused, and a wave of desolation and skeletons sends the troops fleeing as people age rapidly. Elder Ji and Elder Jiang each reveal a forbidden artifact refined by a Supreme Elder that restores their divine power for nine strikes, and they fight their way up the mountain, arguing over whether to trust Ye Fan with the summit.
events: Ye Fan humiliates the Jiang cultivator who hunted him two years before
Elder Jiang links the Forbidden Land's changes to the legendary bronze coffin
Desolation ages the fleeing troops
The elders use Supreme Elder forbidden artifacts granting nine strikes each
They carve a path up the mountain and debate sending Ye Fan to the summit
introduced: bronze coffin legend beneath the abyss
cultivation: Elders Ji and Jiang temporarily restore their cultivation using forbidden artifacts that let their divine power surge nine times.

title: The Tianxuan Holy Maiden Returns
summary: The elders brand Ye Fan with a Puppet Mark, but the ancient scripture lets him resist it while he pretends to obey, and they hand him a bottle able to hold a mountain to collect divine medicine and spring water. On the mountain a beautiful, unaging woman appears; Elder Ji recognizes her from a 6,000-year-old portrait as the Tianxuan Holy Maiden, now a nearly immortal Desolate Slave. The elders unleash a flawed imitation of the Desolate Tower, but their forbidden artifacts are destroyed and they become mortals again, and Ye Fan reveals he was never controlled. Near death as his life force drains, Ye Fan dreams of Pang Bo, revives thanks to divine water, and eats a divine fruit that strengthens his divine sense.
events: Ye Fan resists the Puppet Mark using the ancient scripture
The Tianxuan Holy Maiden appears as a Desolate Slave
The elders use an imitation Desolate Tower, then lose their forbidden artifacts
Ye Fan reveals he was never their puppet
Close to death, he is revived and eats a divine fruit
cultivation: The divine fruit strengthens Ye Fan's divine sense.

title: Breaking Through to Divine Bridge
summary: On the summit Ye Fan fears the ancient clans may see the ancient bronze coffin, so he gathers divine medicine and takes the damaged artifacts of the fallen elders, including the Ji family's Wind-Cloud Banner and the Jiang family's Purple-Copper Bagua Mirror. Below, he rescues Liu Yiyi from four Ji family Life Spring guards using the Void-Shifting Array, breaking it with the Wind-Cloud Banner. Yiyi gives him divine medicine, and he tells her he means to seek greater opportunities in the Eastern Wasteland's Northern Region. Cultivating inside his cauldron with the nine ancient characters from the Dao Scripture to stabilize his Bitter Sea, he eats the divine fruits and breaks through to the Divine Bridge realm, while at Lingxu, disciples wonder why Han Feiyu has not returned.
events: Ye Fan loots the damaged artifacts of the ancient-clan elders
He defeats Ji family guards and their Void-Shifting Array to save Liu Yiyi
Yiyi gives him divine medicine and they part
He uses the nine ancient characters and his cauldron to stabilize his Bitter Sea
He reaches peak Life Spring, then the Divine Bridge realm
cultivation: Ye Fan reaches peak Life Spring and breaks through to the Divine Bridge, the third stage of the Wheel-and-Sea realm; his spiritual perception grows and he can strike objects from a distance.

title: Return to Lingxu Cave Heaven
summary: Ye Fan returns to Lingxu Cave Heaven and reunites with Elder Wu Qingfeng, who tells him the yin tomb sank beneath the Eastern Wasteland and the sect master left to search for it, leaving Elder Han in control. Wu tests Ye Fan, discovers he has reached Divine Bridge, and warns him to keep secret that an Ancient Desolate Sacred Body can cultivate. Ye Fan finds the ancient lamp and plaque he left behind are gone. That night a senior sister and two companions ambush him, demanding to know where Han Feiyu is and blaming him for Li Yun's death; he defeats them without revealing his realm, learns the items were given to Elder Han, and tracks down Han Yishui, the Han elder skilled in artifact refinement.
events: Elder Wu Qingfeng recounts the yin tomb's fate and Elder Han's control of Lingxu
Wu discovers Ye Fan's Divine Bridge cultivation
The ancient lamp and plaque are missing from Ye Fan's room
A senior sister and two disciples attack Ye Fan over Han Feiyu
Ye Fan learns Elder Han took his bronze artifacts
cultivation: Ye Fan's Divine Bridge realm is confirmed by Elder Wu; he hides his true level in the fight.

title: Han Yishui's Hidden Knives
summary: With Elder Wu's backing, Ye Fan confronts Elder Han Yishui, Han Feiyu's grandfather, who at first refuses to return the bronze artifacts but gives them back rather than fight Wu. Wu explains the Dao Palace realm and says Yaochi Sacred Land's ancient scripture is said to be strongest for it, though it lies countless mountains and rivers from Yan State. Han Yishui deduces that Ye Fan killed Han Feiyu and probably has reached the Divine Bridge realm, and sends his disciples to kill him. After Ye Fan gives Elder Wu a vial of life-saving spring water and leaves, the disciples ambush him, and he breaks their battle formation.
events: Ye Fan and Elder Wu confront Han Yishui over the bronze artifacts
Han Yishui returns them to avoid a fight with Wu
Elder Wu explains the Dao Palace and Yaochi Sacred Land
Ye Fan gives Wu life-saving spring water
Han Yishui's disciples ambush Ye Fan, who breaks their formation
cultivation: Ye Fan's Divine Bridge realm is exposed to Han Yishui's disciples.

title: Artifact Duel with Han Yishui
summary: After killing the disciples, Ye Fan waits for Han Yishui, and the two fight an artifact duel: Han's Frost Ruler, Jade Dragon Shield, Nine Immortals Locking Array and Dao Bell against Ye Fan's cauldron and the Green Wood Seal Han himself once refined. Ye Fan reveals he killed Han Feiyu and Han's younger brother, whose ancient-pattern scroll let him carve Dao patterns that conceal the battlefield. Noticing Taiji-like principles in Han's artifact, Ye Fan wins and kills him. He then resolves to find a way to cross the void to distant Yaochi, thinks about turning Taiji into a body cultivation technique, and spots the fat Daoist Duan De at an inn.
events: Ye Fan kills Han Yishui's disciples and waits for him
Han Yishui unleashes a series of artifacts and arrays
Ye Fan admits killing Han Feiyu and Han's younger brother
Ye Fan defeats and kills Han Yishui
He muses on turning Taiji into a body technique and spots Duan De
cultivation: Ye Fan uses Dao patterns copied from the younger Elder Han's beast-hide scroll and begins conceiving a Taiji-based body cultivation technique.

title: Framed by the Fat Daoist
summary: Ye Fan follows Duan De, who mentions a new Demon King rising among the demon race, hoping for news of Pang Bo. He breaks a Five Elements fire-thread array guarding a spiritual stone, only for Duan De to steal Yanxia Cave Heaven's treasure and frame him, so Elder Yuehong and the Yanxia disciples chase him. Ye Fan snatches the stone and questions Duan De, learning it carries a trace of Yaochi Sacred Land's divine power and that sects like Taixuan Sect can cross the void to the Northern Region. When Duan De asks about the Green Copper, Ye Fan shows him a false memory of the Tianxuan madman taking it, then disguises himself as Duan De so that Yanxia orders his capture.
events: Duan De mentions a new Demon King among the demon race
Ye Fan breaks a Five Elements fire array around a spiritual stone
Duan De frames Ye Fan for stealing Yanxia's treasure
Ye Fan interrogates Duan De about the stone and crossing the void
Ye Fan disguises himself as Duan De and turns Yanxia against him

title: Sold in Xuanyuan Valley
summary: Duan De lures Ye Fan into Xuanyuan Valley, where demon maidens of the Azure Emperor's true lineage are bathing, then sells him to Qin Yao for Demon Emperor blood essence, saying it will help him cross the void. The demons reveal that Her Highness has recovered the imperial weapon and the Demon Emperor's Sacred Heart. Ye Fan fights Qin Yao, now in the Dao Palace realm, and demands to see Pang Bo, but Yan Ruyu says Pang Bo is in seclusion and his fate is not yet settled. Overhearing them, Ye Fan learns they want his Ancient Desolate Sacred Body as a sacred vessel, and that Pang Bo's body has not been taken over yet.
events: Duan De tricks Ye Fan into spying on bathing demon maidens
Duan De trades Ye Fan to Qin Yao for Demon Emperor blood essence
Ye Fan fights Qin Yao and loses
Yan Ruyu refuses to let him see Pang Bo, who is in seclusion
Ye Fan overhears plans to use him as a sacred vessel
cultivation: Qin Yao has entered the Dao Palace realm.

title: The Golden Bitter Sea
summary: Qin Yao explains the plan: place the Demon Emperor's Sacred Heart in Ye Fan's Life Spring so his Sacred Body nourishes it, possibly with Yan Ruyu cultivating a supreme art with him, and the demons hope to restore the Azure Emperor's glory. Ye Fan refuses and tries to escape but is recaptured. Yan Ruyu, a Four Extremes realm cultivator, uses the Demon Emperor's sacred weapon to force open his Bitter Sea, revealing it to be golden, but the Green Copper helps Ye Fan block the Sacred Heart from entering. He then finds himself in a strange place where Pang Bo calls to him.
events: Qin Yao explains the sacred vessel plan
Ye Fan's escape attempt fails
Yan Ruyu forces open his Bitter Sea, which proves to be golden
The Green Copper helps Ye Fan block the Sacred Heart
Ye Fan hears Pang Bo calling him in a strange space
introduced: Wheel-and-Sea visions: Bright Moon over the Sea, Golden Lotus in the Bitter Sea, Stars Shining in the Azure Sky
cultivation: Ye Fan's Bitter Sea is shown to be golden, a vision-like phenomenon; Yan Ruyu is revealed to be in the Four Extremes realm.

title: I Am Who I Am
summary: In an illusion, a false Pang Bo urges Ye Fan to merge with the Demon Emperor's Heart, and a figure revealed to be Ye Fan himself tests whether he can endure ridicule, loneliness and temptation; he vows to keep his own path. Guarded by the Green Copper, he takes the Sacred Heart into his Bitter Sea but suppresses it rather than merging, squeezes out drops of Demon Emperor blood essence to transform his body, and seals the heart with his cauldron. The demons believe the nurturing has succeeded. Qin Yao then warns that the Ji clan traced the sacred weapon and has a rare Divine Body to test against them, and Ji cultivators break through the demon barrier.
events: Ye Fan passes an inner trial and chooses his own Dao
He suppresses the Sacred Heart with the Green Copper
He extracts Demon Emperor blood essence to transform his body
He seals the heart's power with his cauldron
The Ji clan attacks the demon hideout
introduced: Demon Emperor blood essence (extracted by Ye Fan)
cultivation: Ye Fan's body is repeatedly transformed by Demon Emperor blood essence while he holds the Sacred Heart in check.

title: Bright Moon Versus Golden Lotus
summary: Ji Haoyue, the Ji clan's Divine Body, confronts Yan Ruyu and demands the Demon Emperor's sacred weapon she took three years earlier with the Treasure-Gathering Basin. When a demon elder tests him, he manifests his Bright Moon over the Sea vision and overwhelms the demons, while a Ji clan Supreme Elder watches. The demons try to break out with a stone coffin that Ye Fan suspects holds Pang Bo. Ji Haoyue then brings out the Void Mirror forged by his ancestor, the Void Great Emperor, to pit against the Azure Emperor's imperial weapon, and Yan Ruyu answers with her own vision, Golden Lotus in the Bitter Sea.
events: Ji Haoyue challenges Yan Ruyu for the sacred weapon
He manifests the Bright Moon over the Sea vision
A Ji clan Supreme Elder oversees the battle
The demons fight to get a stone coffin off the battlefield
Ji Haoyue wields the Void Mirror; Yan Ruyu reveals Golden Lotus in the Bitter Sea
introduced: Mystic Light of the Four Directions
cultivation: Ji Haoyue reveals the Bright Moon over the Sea vision; Yan Ruyu reveals the Golden Lotus in the Bitter Sea vision.

title: Kidnapping the Ji Heiress
summary: The imperial weapons clash while the stone coffin escapes, and the demons retreat in separate groups. A Ji girl using the Void-Shifting Art catches Ye Fan and Qin Yao until Yan Ruyu intervenes; Yan tells Ye Fan that Pang Bo is out of danger and parts with him before heading for Peacock King Manor in the Southern Region. When the Ji girl catches up, Ye Fan seals her divine power with Dao patterns, uses her as a shield and escapes down an underground river. She reveals she is Ji Haoyue's younger sister and bears a mark that will alert the Ji clan if she dies, so Ye Fan settles for robbing her of her treasures.
events: Ji Haoyue and Yan Ruyu clash imperial weapons
A Ji girl with the Void-Shifting Art pursues Ye Fan and Qin Yao
Yan Ruyu says Pang Bo is safe and parts ways with Ye Fan
Ye Fan seals the Ji girl's divine power and takes her hostage
She reveals she is Ji Haoyue's sister; he robs her
cultivation: Ye Fan seals a stronger cultivator's divine power with Dao patterns.

title: Inside the Bronze Immortal Palace
summary: The underground river carries Ye Fan and his hostage to the Bronze Immortal Palace, a legendary palace drifting on the Netherworld River from which no one returns, apart from an immortal's corpse that was once divided among the sacred lands and ancient clans. They find wax-sealed corpses of cultivators from before the Ancient Desolate era, which reanimate and attack. Deeper inside they find the remains of famous Eastern Wasteland powerhouses and a lingering image of the Tianxuan cultivator Yang Yizhen and his junior sister killing each other over the pursuit of immortality. Facing likely death, the two finally trade names: Ye Fan and Ji Ziyue.
events: They are swept into the Bronze Immortal Palace
Ji Ziyue explains the legend of the immortal's corpse
Wax corpses reanimate and attack
They witness a lingering image of Yang Yizhen's fatal duel
Ye Fan and Ji Ziyue exchange names

title: Corpses Who Think They're Immortal
summary: Chaos, which Ji clan records say erodes bone and soul, surges through the palace, but the Green Copper moves on its own to block it. Ye Fan asks for the Ji clan's Void Scripture in exchange for its secret, and Ziyue refuses. They meet undying corpses from Tianxuan, the Ji clan and Yaochi who claim that eating divine medicine made them immortal while they wait for the road to immortality to open. Ye Fan calls them walking corpses controlled by obsession, lends Ziyue a Ji elder's artifact with stored divine power, and destroys the force at their leader's heart. At the Gates of Life and Death, he reasons through Taiji and chooses the Gate of Death.
events: The Green Copper blocks the palace's chaos
Ye Fan bargains for the Void Scripture and is refused
Self-proclaimed immortals who ate divine medicine attack
Ye Fan destroys the force animating them at their leader's heart
He chooses the Gate of Death by Taiji reasoning

title: Xuanhuang Mother Qi
summary: Past the Gate of Death they find blood-written characters meaning 'immortal' and heavenly Dao chants, and a bronze ring Ziyue took from her clan's ancestral hall pulls Ye Fan into an illusion that drains his life until the Green Copper saves him. The Gate of Myriad Wonders opens, but both decline to go in and instead escape through a breach someone punched in the palace, agreeing to keep the palace secret. Outside, Ye Fan recognizes Xuanhuang Qi, able to forge an Extreme Dao weapon, and its crushing essence, Xuanhuang Mother Qi, and they flee its pressure until the copper fragment absorbs some. Ziyue urges him to take in more with his cauldron.
events: Blood characters meaning 'immortal' carry killing intent
A bronze ring's illusion nearly kills Ye Fan
They pass up the Gate of Myriad Wonders and escape through a breach
They discover Xuanhuang Qi and Xuanhuang Mother Qi
The Green Copper absorbs Mother Qi

title: Forcing Out the Void Scripture
summary: With the Green Copper suppressing the Xuanhuang Mother Qi inside him, Ye Fan uses the Demon Emperor's Heart to absorb it and squeezes out more blood essence to transform his body and reforge his cauldron. Ziyue uses the golden light radiating from his body to wear down her seal, sees the Demon Emperor's heart inside him, and attacks once she regains a little divine power. Ye Fan subdues her with Mother Qi around his fist, re-seals her and demands the Void Scripture. After refusing and claiming a curse protects it, she writes some out, and Ye Fan learns the Dao Palace requires cultivating five deities before the text stops.
events: The Demon Emperor's Heart absorbs Xuanhuang Mother Qi inside Ye Fan
More blood essence transforms Ye Fan's body
Ziyue weakens her seal and sees the Demon Emperor's Heart
Ye Fan beats her with Mother Qi around his fist
Ziyue writes out part of the Void Scripture
cultivation: Ye Fan's body transforms again with Demon Emperor blood essence and he begins fusing Xuanhuang Mother Qi into his cauldron and fist.

title: Ji Xia's Assassination Attempt
summary: Ye Fan jokingly proposes a marriage alliance as the solution to Ziyue being unable to go free or be killed. He kills a strange bird, which turns out to be the pet of her cousin Ji Biyue, revealing their location. Ji Biyue's servant Ji Xia arrives, mocks Ziyue and tries to kill her, so Ye Fan lures Ji Xia deep underground and triggers the Xuanhuang Qi. The Qi shatters her Divine Light Escape Talisman, and Ye Fan beats the Other Shore realm cultivator to death with his fists. The talisman's released power breaks Ziyue's seal, and she retaliates by biting him over the Mother Qi.
events: Ye Fan proposes a marriage alliance
He kills Ji Biyue's pet bird, exposing their location
Ji Xia comes to kill Ziyue

cultivation: Though at the Divine Bridge realm, Ye Fan kills an Other Shore (peak Wheel-and-Sea) cultivator with his bare fists.

title: Trials at Taixuan Sect
summary: Ziyue explains that Ji Biyue wants her dead to win the Ji clan's Great Emperor inheritance. She refuses to give up the Void Scripture, but offers to take Ye Fan to Taixuan Sect, whose 108 main peaks and mysterious ancient art rival an Ancient Desolate clan, and both disguise themselves. At the recruitment they meet Li Xiaoman, addressed as Junior Sister Li, now a Taixuan disciple, and Star Peak's top disciple, Senior Brother Chen, picks a fight with Ye Fan until Elder Xu stops it. The second trial requires crossing a stone gate before one's flame goes out, testing Dao Palace potential.
events: Ziyue reveals her cousin Ji Biyue's motive
They travel in disguise to Taixuan Sect
Ye Fan meets Junior Sister Li (Li Xiaoman)
Senior Brother Chen of Star Peak attacks Ye Fan
Elder Xu begins the flame-and-stone-gate trial

title: The Nine-Step Heavenly Stairway
summary: Ye Fan deliberately fails the flame trial, then retakes it on pain of death and passes by smashing everything around the flame. He chooses Clumsy Peak, which holds the Jie Secret, one of the Nine Secrets scattered from an ancient scripture, able to multiply combat power up to tenfold. The peak's sleepy elder, Li Ruoyu, explains its inheritance has been severed for 500 years since its peak master died fighting a Yaoguang Supreme Elder. Mocked by Star Peak disciples, Ziyue attempts the Nine-Step Heavenly Stairway and tries to leap straight to the eighth step against raven constructs of natural forces.
events: Ye Fan passes the flame trial on his second attempt
He chooses Clumsy Peak for the Jie Secret
Elder Li Ruoyu recounts the peak's severed inheritance
Ziyue takes on the Nine-Step Heavenly Stairway
She skips steps and faces the raven trials

title: Great Skill Seems Clumsy
summary: Using her Primordial Spirit Physique to command heaven-and-earth qi, Ziyue destroys the raven constructs with thunder and reaches the ninth step, which tests potential up to the Immortal Platform. Star Peak's elders, including one Li Ruoyu calls Senior Brother Li, ask to take her, and she agrees to go to Star Peak while Ye Fan hides his strength to stay at Clumsy Peak. Elder Li leaves him only twelve words from a predecessor and ignores his questions about the Domain Gate, so Ye Fan tries winning him over with roast meat. He beats Star Peak disciples who come to accuse him of desecrating the peak, and they deliver notice of an inter-peak competition in three months.
events: Ziyue conquers all nine steps with her Primordial Spirit Physique
Star Peak takes Ziyue; Ye Fan stays at Clumsy Peak
Elder Li gives Ye Fan twelve cryptic words
Ye Fan roasts meat to win the elder over
He drives off trespassing Star Peak disciples
cultivation: Ziyue reveals her Primordial Spirit Physique by clearing the ninth step.

title: The Clumsy Bow Reappears
summary: Following Elder Li's mutterings about ravens, Ye Fan finds a broken bow in the ravens' nest. When Star Peak's Senior Brother Yang comes to punish him, Li Ruoyu tells Ye Fan to use it, and the Clumsy Bow, the peak's guardian treasure, merges with the nine ravens to drive the Star Peak group off; they apologize, taking the bow's return as a sign the inheritance will revive. Li Ruoyu merges the bow with the mountain, enters meditation to awaken the inheritance, and gives Ye Fan his cultivation journal. Posing as a mere Bitter Sea cultivator, Ye Fan beats the Life Spring disciples who come to intimidate him into rebuilding Clumsy Peak's gate, and signs of enlightenment beneath a Bodhi tree suggest the secret art may soon appear.
events: Ye Fan finds a broken bow in the ravens' nest
The Clumsy Bow and nine ravens repel Star Peak
Li Ruoyu merges the bow with the mountain and enters meditation
